subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Caravan Ribat

40040101.text: Good ol' Caravan Ribat. Huh, now let Paimon think... What were we up to the first time we came here?

40040102.text: Oh, Paimon remembers... Nahida's consciousness had been trapped by The Doctor, but we followed the clues she left behind to help her!

40040105.text: So much time has already passed since then, and it seems Sumeru's changing for the better now that Nahida's in charge, right?

40040106.text: Paimon just hopes this peace will last a long time, and then Nahida won't have any more new problems to deal with.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Romaritime Harbor in Fontaine

40040201.text: Whew, after crossing all that sand and water, we finally made it... This must be Fontaine's port.

40040202.text: Wow, everything looks so advanced in Fontaine. Paimon's heard that the industry here is extremely developed, and there are all kinds of unusual machines.

40040205.text: Just seeing the sights as tourists is nice, but maybe it would be better if we found something to do.

40040207.text: Let's start by meeting the Hydro Archon.

40040208.text: Good idea. Nahida gave us loads of useful information.

40040209.text: Seeking out The Seven is probably still our best source for information at this point.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the young woman by the water

40040302.text: Uh, hello there! Excuse me! Are you alright?

40040305.text: Oh, okay then. We just noticed that you seemed to be worried about something.

40040306.text: About many things, actually... But there's nothing I can do but just keep my troubles to myself.

40040307.text: I was just reminiscing about a place my brother and I would play when we were kids. It was just atop that hill over there, see?

40040308.text: Uh, you're pointing at the sea... Wait, are you saying that you and your brother lived in the water?

40040311.text: Though people call the waters around Fontaine a "sea," it's actually just an inland lake that's filled with fresh water.

40040312.text: And though I can still see that hill clearly in my memories, now it's been completely submerged.

40040313.text: He would skip and jump, tossing sand in the wind... The sun shone brightly and the air was filled with the scent of the sea.

40040314.text: But now the water is gradually swallowing our memories...

40040315.text: It won't be long before it swallows us.

40040316.text: Uh, sorry, Paimon doesn't really get what you mean.

40040317.text: Ah, I don't believe we've had the pleasure of meeting. Are you Lynette's new friends?

40040319.text: Thanks for looking after my sister, she often comes here to reminisce about our childhood, that's all. There's no need for any concern.

40040320.text: Ah, allow me to introduce myself. I'm Lyney, and this is my sister, Lynette. If I had to guess, I'd say you must be travelers from abroad.

40040321.text: #Nice to meet you, Paimon is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}. We just arrived in Fontaine.

40040322.text: We were just talking with your sister, uh... even though we didn't really get what she was saying.

40040323.text: Hmm, I see. It's unusual for Lynette to be so willing to talk with anyone, in fact, she seldom speaks at all. I'm usually the only one she ever talks to.

40040324.text: Oh, really? Then you two are just like us! Paimon's always the one talking for some reason.

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow Lyney

40041701.text: But where would I move to? Snezhnaya? Liyue?

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow Lyney

40040401.text: Uh, you said you were going to see Lady Furina? Well, it seems Lady Furina has come to see you.

40040402.text: Huh!? So... she's the Hydro Archon? But how did she know we were looking for her?

40040403.text: My dear people, rich and poor, those with cup in hand and those with nothing at all, raise your glasses in celebration! If you don't have one, then just raise your hand in lieu.

40040404.text: #As you can all see, two unfamiliar travelers have arrived in our nation. Come, let us make a toast in honor of this Traveler and {M#his}{F#her} companion who have journeyed here from distant lands!

40040405.text: Uh...? Is she talking about us?

40040406.text: (Nobody here seems to be holding a glass...)

40040407.text: I've long heard of the turmoil and chaos you've left in your wake as you visited other nations, but I welcome you nevertheless... No, I have come to receive you personally.

40040408.text: Fear is for insignificant cowards. I am a god, and I will never entertain the notion of such meaningless wariness. You can be rest assured, I see clearly your sincerity.

40040409.text: Of course, seeking an audience with me is the most sensible thing to do. It will allow you to truly behold my power and witness my authority. Intelligent people always gather under the correct banner.

40040410.text: I, Focalors, hereby welcome you to the nation of Hydro and acknowledge the value and significance of your trip. Now, you may rejoice in this!

40040411.text: Well, finding the Archon was easy enough...

40040412.text: Yeah, Paimon still can't believe it... It feels like we've only been here for a few minutes.

40040413.text: But the Hydro Archon's entrance was, uh... How should Paimon describe it...? A little over the top?

40040414.text: Ahem... Uh, Miss Hydro Archon... How did you know we were coming?

40040415.text: Ah, I see. As outlanders, you inevitably lack even some of the most basic understanding. Don't forget that even the gods can be divided into the mediocre and the excellent. I suppose it's only natural for you to be awestruck by my abilities.

40040416.text: You had best stop and consider... do you really have the noble qualities and etiquette necessary to communicate with a god? All it takes is a flick of my finger for me to know everything about you.

40040417.text: Whoa, talk about sounding high and mighty...

40040418.text: Feels like she can't get over herself...

40040420.text: Oh? What's with these looks? Perhaps the welcoming ceremony still isn't enough? Hmm, what else should I say then?

40040422.text: Uh, is she waiting for us to start talking?

40040423.text: Wow, I didn't expect to see Lady Furina here. What a surprise!

40040424.text: #Wait, does this mean they're the "Legendary {F#Blonde}{M#Blond} Traveler"!? How did I not notice before?

40040425.text: Hey, what's all the commotion? Oh, is that Lady Furina? Is there some kinda drama going on?

40040426.text: #Of course! That's the {F#Blonde}{M#Blond} Traveler, the one all those stories are about. Lady Furina came here to personally see {M#him}{F#her}... Oh, I bet this is going to be the duel of the century!

40040427.text: Oh! I've got to see this! I knew Lady Furina would never disappoint!

40040428.text: Ahaha! Yes, but don't get too excited now... My dear believers and spectators alike tend to get quite rowdy, and despite the noise, I've come to tolerate all their ruckus.

40040429.text: You may consider this my reward to all of you! I have determined that there will be an epic duel between myself and this traveler from another land, just as you were hoping to see!

40040430.text: Huh!? Now she wants to fight? Aren't we getting a little ahead of ourselves?

40040433.text: Hmm? Hmph! A—Are you not afraid? Might I remind you that this is a duel against the divine!

40040434.text: What are you trying to do, Traveler? Provoking a god in front of her people?

40040435.text: #Ahem, stand down, Clorinde. I admire {M#his}{F#her} bravery, few have the courage to draw their sword against a god. {M#He}{F#She} is obviously a true warrior.

40040436.text: Unfortunately, people nowadays only crave to be thrilled, and a mere duel will not slake their thirst for excitement!

40040437.text: ...Yeah, she's right. Just a duel wouldn't be all that interesting...

40040438.text: On Erinnyes, criminals are always requesting duels to defend their honor. They're getting a bit old, to tell the truth.

40040439.text: You see... then as the god of justice, I shall face this Traveler in another kind of duel... a duel in court!

40040440.text: Whoa! Oooh, alright, now that'll be worth seeing!

40040441.text: Right, this is Fontaine, after all. With such a grand opera house, it would be a pity not to use it.

40040442.text: Why do you care so much about the crowd's reactions? Seems you've spent a little too much time in the opera house...

40040443.text: Besides, how exactly do you plan to have a duel in court? You mean you're going to put us on trial?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Lyney

40040501.text: And just like that, she's gone. Well, that's the most unpredictable archon Paimon's ever seen... We never even had a chance to ask her anything, but that's a problem for future Paimon! That whole scene just now was really...

40040504.text: Don't mention it. I just happened to remember that there was such a law, so I did a little preparation — just in case. I didn't think it would actually come in handy.

40040505.text: So, now do you see what kind of god Lady Furina is?

40040506.text: She can be a bit confusing at times, but she is still amenable to reason.

subQuests.subQuestName: Distribute Magic Pockets to the nearby residents

40040601.text: #So you're the {F#blonde}{M#blond} Traveler that everyone's been talking about. My apologies for not recognizing you earlier.

40040602.text: Oh, a Magic Pocket...? Seems you really thought of everything. I guess it's better to prepare for the worst and hope for the best...

40040603.text: Thanks. Please also thank the magician on my behalf when you get the chance.

subQuests.subQuestName: Distribute Magic Pockets to the nearby residents

40040701.text: Huh? Ah, I don't want that thing. Way I see it, if the prophecy's true, it's still gonna be a long time before the water can cover everything.

40040702.text: Life is all about living in the moment. What use is there in worrying about the future all the time? We'll cross that bridge when we get to it.

40040703.text: You should still take it, you never know when it will come in handy.

40040704.text: Oh, alright... fine. Thanks. It's just that... if I start moving, that means I've already given up on the life I have now. I'd really rather not...

subQuests.subQuestName: Distribute Magic Pockets to the nearby residents

40040801.text: What's this... So you also believe in the prophecy? Hehe, keep it, I won't have any use for it.

40040802.text: What? You mean you don't believe in the prophecy?

40040803.text: No, no, I believe in the prophecy, but I also believe in another story.

40040804.text: The story says that people once lived in the ocean. They were one with the ocean and couldn't live apart from it.

40040805.text: But as time wore on, people desired to live on land and developed blood vessels, encapsulating the sea within their bodies. Thus could people set foot on land.

40040806.text: So if you ask me, when the water rises and takes us all, it'll be like we're going home.

40040807.text: Oh, we hadn't heard that one before... But, people can't live underwater, they'll die... You should probably still take it.

40040808.text: Ah, alright, I'll take it. I guess I just feel that being "dissolved into the water" doesn't necessarily mean death.

40041601.text: Hey, how about we get some tickets to the next trial?

40041602.text: Hmm, I think we'd better wait and see what kind of case it is first.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Lyney

40040901.text: Oh? You already handed out all of the Magic Pockets? That was fast. So, what did people have to say? I bet you heard some, ah, interesting opinions...

40040904.text: Yes, but that will change once disaster strikes. I know they'll change their minds, so it's only right to help them prepare.

40040905.text: Is there anything else you need to do before we leave?

40040906.text: Yes, one last thing. I have the Magic Pockets made by a workshop in the Court of Fontaine. Since we're out and about, I was thinking about bringing him some more materials.

40040907.text: So you want to collect materials? Just tell us what the materials look like and we'll help. Many hands make light work!

40040908.text: Ah, that would be much appreciated. We'll need some Romaritime Flowers, I remember seeing them near the waterfront on the east side of the harbor.

subQuests.subQuestName: Collect materials used to make Magic Pockets
Collect materials used to make Magic Pockets

40042006.text: I never guessed I'd bump into you while riding the aquabus. In the story of my life, this is big news!

40042007.text: What are you doing in Fontaine? I didn't hear anything about you paying us a visit.

40042008.text: Yeah, it's quite the coincidence! But as Travelers, we're always on the move. It's not surprising that nobody knew we were coming.

40042009.text: Uh, though we still have no idea how the Hydro Archon knew about us... Oh! Let Paimon introduce you to our new friends!

40042010.text: Oh, no need for introductions, Paimon. I would recognize the Great Magician Lyney and his assistant Lynette anywhere.

40042011.text: I wouldn't be much of a reporter if I didn't know who they were. It's a pleasure to meet you! I'm Charlotte, a reporter for The Steambird.

40042012.text: Nice to meet you. From The Steambird, huh? We've often relied on your paper to promote our performances.

40042013.text: It's an honor to meet you.

40042014.text: Oh, now that everyone knows each other, Fontaine suddenly doesn't feel like such an unfamiliar place.

40042015.text: So, what have you been up to lately, Charlotte? Any big news?

40042016.text: Not too much... when there isn't any breaking news, I mainly cover the trials at the opera house...

40042017.text: You can still manage to keep readers' attention as long as you tell things from a clever enough angle, even if it's the same old topics.

40042018.text: For example, reporting on how a scammer once deceived vulnerable girls into relationships, or how a financial criminal was once so poor that they ate a single piece of bread for five days...

40042021.text: *sigh* You're right, seems you know me pretty well. What I'm really after is exclusive, sensational news pieces that could shake the country. These smaller stories are a waste of my talents.

40041318.text: Oh, I just remembered... I've been following a case lately... well, a series of cases, actually...

40041319.text: You mean the "serial disappearances of young women" case?

40041320.text: That's right. These stories are the talk of the town right now, and it's probably the most mysterious case we've ever seen.

40041321.text: If I'm the first with a draft ready to publish when the case is finally cracked, and it's the headline story in The Steambird...

40041322.text: When that happens, I bet all the other reporters will shed tears of envy. I've already gathered all kinds of materials, I just can't wait for the truth to be revealed.

40041323.text: So what is the "serial disappearances of young women" case? You mean the culprit hasn't been found?

40041324.text: That's right. The first missing girl case happened almost twenty years ago.

40041325.text: And ever since, after a period of time, another girl disappears. What the cases have in common is that the girls are all of a similar age, and that they've all vanished without a trace.

40041326.text: But the scariest part is that to this day, none of the girls have ever been found.

40041327.text: Many suspects have been arrested over the years in connection with this case. But shortly after each arrest, another disappearance would always happen.

subQuests.subQuestName: Collect materials used to make Magic Pockets

40041901.text: What do you think? Pretty interesting story, huh?

40041801.text: I really can't imagine what it would be like if things changed...

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Lyney

40041101.text: You made quick work of that, I can tell you're an experienced traveler. I've also finished collecting a few here.

40041102.text: Maybe next time you'll feel like helping too, Lynette.

40041103.text: No way. I'm in power-saving mode today. Otherwise, I fear I may not have any energy left for the performance at the opera house.

40041104.text: *sigh* Fine, though the performance is still a long way off. Now that we're finished here, we should get ready to head back to the Court of Fontaine.

40041105.text: So we're going to the Court of Fontaine before we head to the opera house? Good, Paimon wants a tour of Fontaine's largest city and try—

40041106.text: Wait... Shh! Have you noticed that person over there? The young girl...

40041107.text: Huh? What's wrong with her? Paimon didn't notice anything.

40041109.text: Magicians and thieves practice similar methods. We divert attention, and a distracted audience is one that won't discover what you're really doing.

40041112.text: Shh! Keep your voice down... We need to think of a way to catch her, but it seems she's very alert. Perhaps we should split up.

40041113.text: You two can ride the lift over there and wait up top. I bet that'll be her escape route if she tries to run.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the top of the lift to cut off the thief's escape

40041201.text: This is the spot where Lyney wanted us to wait.

40041205.text: Oh no, did she notice us? She started running the other direction!

40041206.text: What should we do? Should we chase her?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Lyney

40041501.text: Are you sure that's all she took? You should check to make sure you're not missing anything else.

40041502.text: No, that was all. I can't thank you enough, I didn't notice a thing earlier.

40041503.text: Anyway, I should be going now. Thanks again.

40041504.text: Oh, were you returning what the thief had stolen?

40041505.text: That's right, pity I wasn't able to catch her. She distracted me by dropping the things she stole on the ground. By the time I looked back, she was already gone.

40041506.text: I saw the general direction she went, but Lyney twisted his ankle, and I needed to make sure he was okay.

40041507.text: Oh? Did you get hurt, Lyney?

40041508.text: I'll be alright. It's just a twisted ankle, that's all. In fact, it's feeling better already.

40041509.text: If you want to play at being a hero, at least try not to get hurt doing it. Imagine what would happen if you managed to derail our performance as a result.

40041510.text: Haha... You're right, you're right! Sorry, Lynette.

40041511.text: *sigh* I have to admit, that thief was even more skilled than I had anticipated.

40041512.text: But at least we were able to get the stolen items back, so it wasn't a complete failure.

40041513.text: What a slippery little thief... Guess things turned out alright in the end though. Lyney's initiative paid off!

40041514.text: Alright, let's put this little detour behind us. We should go to the Court of Fontaine now.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ride the aquabus to the Court of Fontaine

40041401.text: Hmm? Hey, we're almost there. Look!

40041402.text: Well, I really enjoyed chatting with you. Life should be full of pleasant little surprises like this.

40041403.text: Yeah, us as well! The ride went by too quickly.

40041404.text: Ah! I have an interview to get to. I should get going before I'm late.

40041405.text: Okay, Paimon hopes we can chat again soon, Charlotte. See ya!

40041406.text: Hehe, bye now. Be sure to stop by and see me at The Steambird when you have time!

40041407.text: What a tough job... always running around and interviewing everyone. Well, where should we go now?

40041408.text: If you don't mind, how about we stop by my home first? Besides, I still have all the materials we collected.

40041409.text: Sure, we wouldn't mind at all. This city is so huge, Paimon wouldn't know where to start anyway.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ride the aquabus to the Court of Fontaine

40042601.text: Wanted: Name unknown. Seeking any and all relevant information.

40042602.text: Male, Fontainian. One leg is a prosthetic replacement. Known alias: Mr. Sawleg. Has conducted illegal performances at Romaritime Station, resulting in a disruption of public order.

40042603.text: Rewards are available for information leading to the capture of this individual. If you have any related information, please contact the Maison Gardiennage.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ride the aquabus to the Court of Fontaine
Ride the aquabus to the Court of Fontaine

40042401.text: Attention all visitors! Any and all dueling within Fontaine will require application and registration with the appropriate authorities.

40042402.text: Private, unapproved duels are strictly prohibited. Any participants will be punished to the fullest extent of the law. Any and all losses and damages resulting from unauthorized private duels will be borne by the participants.

40042403.text: Arrests made by the Maison Gardiennage are not considered duels or dueling behavior! If you wish to uphold your honor, you may apply for a duel during the trial process. Refrain from any last-ditch resistance if you wish to avoid meaningless losses.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Court of Fontaine

40042101.text: This bulletin board has been specially set up by the Harbormaster of Romaritime Harbor to publicize all important matters in and around the harbor. Any questions may also be posted here.

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional

40042501.text: The Maison Gardiennage would like to remind you that Romaritime Harbor is near the desert, and large numbers of illegal individuals calling themselves Eremites have been active nearby. Merchants passing through should remain vigilant.

40042502.text: If you see something, say something! Contact the Maison Gardiennage to deal with any suspicious persons.

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional
Additional

40049901.text: It seems we have to use Hydro to collect Romaritime Flowers.

40049902.text: You continue talking on the aquabus, and before you know it, you are arriving at your destination.

40049903.text: After settling matters in Sumeru, you approach the border with Fontaine...
